read.thesis: Q2 organic sales +2% with Performance Coatings +6% and EPS guide $7.75–$8.05 reiterated; Industrial H2 recovery rests entirely on share gains, not market demand, and Architectural Europe was cut.

capex.quote: We just announced a new aerospace factory in the United States this past quarter at about $380 million CapEx cost, and we continue to invest in debottlenecking.

triggers.label: New US aerospace factory ~$380M capex
triggers.quote: We just announced a new aerospace factory in the United States this past quarter at about $380 million CapEx cost

triggers.label: Architectural Europe guide cut
triggers.quote: We did adjust down our outlook, particularly for Europe.

triggers.label: Industrial H2 growth is share-gain only
triggers.quote: that confidence that you're hearing from us for the second half is entirely share gain driven.

triggers.label: Q2 Industrial prices down 1%
triggers.quote: Selling prices declined 1% due to carryover of certain index-based customer contracts.

guidance.quote: We are reiterating our full year guidance per share range of $7.75 to $8.05, and we have a clear path to achieve it.

guidance.value: high single digit; Q3 mid-single digit, Q4 low double digit
guidance.quote: resulting in a mid-single-digit percentage increase in EPS for the third quarter and a low double-digit percentage increase for the fourth quarter.
We're about a $30 million clip through the first half.
We sized our annual share gains in the Industrial segment at $100 million, and we are tracking to that annualized figure.

red_flags.label: Performance Coatings incrementals weak; opex diverted
red_flags.quote: we made a conscious decision to spend more on OpEx, growth-focused OpEx

red_flags.label: Refinish Q3 soft; recovery seen 2026
red_flags.quote: we're not expecting industry recovery of claim rates and body shop work likely until 2026.

evasions.quote: I would have wanted the net margin for Performance Coatings to drop more EBIT, EBITDA and cash to the bottom line.
